title: Technical Management of BOA TRADE
welcomeText2: Use the side menu to access available features.
telaInicialHeadline: Professional Technical Management — Operation, Customers and Reports in One Place.
telaInicialSubtitle: The definitive solution for service and maintenance management. Transform your business with cutting-edge technology and intelligent automation.
telaInicialClaim: Integrated platform for technical management, customers and service reports.
dashboardEntradaSub: Here is the essentials about the platform. Continue to the full operational dashboard with metrics, shortcuts and warehouse inventory — when you need them.
dashboardEntradaCard1Desc: Reports, protocols, checklists and inspections in one coherent flow for your team.
dashboardEntradaCard2Desc: Records, history and asset tracking per customer — data always at hand.
dashboardEntradaCard3Desc: Parts, manuals, orders and stock aligned with real warehouse operations.
dashboardEntradaCard4Desc: Costs, budgets and internal channels to close the loop with transparency.
dashboardEntradaNota: The side menu is always available. Use the Help button (or F1) at the top of this area; inside each open module, the same button explains the current screen.
dashboardShowcaseSlide1Desc: Visual protocols, parts used, professional PDF and client delivery — all in a clear workflow.
dashboardShowcaseSlide2Desc: Full registration, history per client, equipment IDs and real-time tracking.
dashboardShowcaseSlide3Desc: Organized catalog, URL import, smart numbering and enlarged images.
dashboardShowcaseSlide4Desc: Bible, manuals, PDFs and technical sheets unified by family, brand and model.
dashboardShowcaseSlide5Desc: Stock, parts separation, preparation orders and warehouse linked to operations.
dashboardShowcaseSlide6Desc: Quotes, costs, internal messages and financial closing with transparency.
dashboardShowcaseHint: Modules rotate automatically — tap a button or use the arrows.
dashboardShowcaseSlide7Desc: Paste supplier pages, analyze duplicates in red and yellow, and import only new parts.
dashboardShowcaseSlide8Desc: Service orders, technician visits and real-time status — nothing gets lost in operations.
dashboardShowcaseSlide9Desc: Volume sequence, warehouse labels and tracking from machine to truck.
dashboardShowcaseSlide10Desc: Office, field and server aligned — send and load data on all devices.
mainModuleIntroFallback: Use the area below to work in this module. Click the arrow to show or hide this summary.
importacaoConfirmarLimparFila: Are you sure you want to clear the import queue? This action deletes pending pieces (not yet saved) and cannot be undone.
mainHubIntro: Pick a module below — the same shortcuts as in the side menu.
checklistHubIntro: Full checklist workflow — from family structure to final inspection before delivery.
mainHubCardHint: Open this area in the system.

logoPainelControloDesc: Image or MP4 Video. Appears in the sidebar and system headers (after login).
recursosQueFazemDiferencaDesc: Discover the features that will revolutionise the way you manage your services
card1Desc: Complete system to manage clients, service history and keep all data organised intelligently.
card2Desc: Track all services and maintenance in real time, with detailed reports and status control.
card3Desc: Carry out detailed inspections with custom checklists and maintain automated quality control.
card4Desc: Complete performance analyses and business insights for strategic decision-making.
card5Desc: Advanced data protection with encryption, automatic backup and granular access control.
card6Desc: Access the system from anywhere, on any device, with real-time synchronisation.
permissoesDefinidasAdministrador: Permissions are defined in the Administrator.
loginSubtitle: Secure environment · access controlled by the Administrator.
loginHintBlankUser: Username and password are required. Use the email or name registered in Administrator.
loginFirstAccessHint: First access: use a password with at least 4 characters. Then configure users in Administrator.
loginSessionRequired: Sign in to access the technical management panel and your data.
splashStep1Desc: Sign in with username and password — credentials set by the administrator.
splashStep2Desc: The system aligns server, cloud and local copy automatically.
splashStep3Desc: Sidebar menu, shortcuts and F1 help in every module.
demoExpiredDesc: The demonstration period has ended. Contact us for full access.
aindaNaoHaUsuarios: There are no users yet. Use a password from the Password Manager to log in and register users in the Administrator.
sidebarGroupExtraDesc: Translator, manager manual, demonstrations and supporting tools.
adminPanelIndexLead: All sections start collapsed to keep the screen tidy. Use the shortcuts below or click each block title to expand only what you need.
confiancaSub: After each update: 8 steps (~10 min) — without replaying the entire program.
confiancaLead: After each update, only perform these steps (about 10 minutes). If everyone passes, you can be more confident in your day-to-day life — without going over the entire program.
confiancaTudoOk: Complete checklist. Keep this trust until the next published change.
confiancaStep_abrirApp: Open the app and see the home panel
confiancaStep_letraInicial: Tap a letter — only customers of that initial letter
confiancaStep_detalheValores: Open a client — see financial situation / values
confiancaStep_fechamentoGrupo: Closing — changing rate group updates unit €
confiancaStep_devedorVermelho: Customer with “unpaid” appears in red (Debtor badge)
confiancaStep_whatsapp: Send report — “Send via WhatsApp” button opens WhatsApp
confiancaStep_backupServidor: Administrator → Backup / Send everything to server (Stable PC)
adminJumpPapelTimbradoDesc: A4 template with logo and contact details
papelTimbradoSubtitle: Configure the header, then print or save as PDF (A4).
papelTimbradoLogoHint: Use PNG (default: /brand/nonato-logo-papel-timbrado.png, vertical logo). Place the file in public/brand/ or enter another URL / base64 data.
papelTimbradoDicaImpressao: In the browser print dialog choose «Save as PDF» for a digital file.
papelTimbradoSincronizarCadastroHint: Uses the saved record under «Nonato Service registration» (address, phone, name and logo). Save on the letterhead afterwards to keep it.
papelTimbradoSemFichaCadastro: No data in registration. Open the system, go to «Nonato Service registration», fill in and save, then use «Pull from registration».
adminJumpSidebarDesc: Drag buttons between areas and positions
adminJumpBackupDesc: 5 latest of each type + individual restore
adminJumpPecasBackupDesc: JSON for the parts library only — codes, prices and images
adminPecasBackupSub: JSON for the parts library only — codes, prices, categories and images.
adminPecasBackupHint: Download or restore only the parts library (codes, descriptions, prices, categories and images). Not mixed with «Send everything to server».
adminPecasBackupExportOk: Parts backup downloaded ({n} parts, {img} with image).
adminPecasBackupImportInvalid: Invalid file or no parts. Expected parts library JSON.
adminPecasBackupImportEmpty: Import blocked: the file has no parts.
adminPecasBackupMergeConfirm: Merge this backup with the current library? Existing parts are updated by id/code; nothing is deleted unless it is in the file.
adminPecasBackupReplaceConfirm: REPLACE the current library with this file? Parts missing from the JSON will be removed from this device. Explicit confirmation required.
adminPecasBackupImportSaveWarn: Parts updated in memory; server upload may have failed — check the connection.
adminGeralSummarySub: Interface language, service report numbering, interface logos, brand identity and logos on PDFs.
adminDemosSummarySub: Recipients, module packages and copying identified links.
adminSyncHubDesc: Keep PC, tablet and phone aligned with the server. The decision is manual — load or send when it makes sense.
adminSyncHubActionPullDesc: Bring the latest server copy here
adminSyncHubActionPushDesc: Publish on the server what is on this device
adminDemosHubDesc: Create personalized links, generate credentials and send via WhatsApp, email or copy.
adminDemosHubWarnTitle: Do not mix with the main program
adminDemosHubWarnBody: Send the link only to clients. Do not open demo links in the browser where you work on the real system — use a private window or another browser to test.
adminDemosHubExitDemo: Exit demo mode in this browser
adminDemosHubOpenFull: Open full screen in a tab
adminDemosHubSearchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or username…
adminDemosHubListHint: Click a name to see link, credentials, status and actions.
adminDemosHubModeFullDesc: Choose a ready profile or all modules at once
adminDemosHubModeStepDesc: Configure each module one at a time, at your pace
adminUsersSummarySub: Accounts, visible modules and link to managers or technicians.
adminClientePriorSummarySub: Featured company: identity, address, contacts and photo for forms and workflows.
adminPasswordsSummarySub: Exclusive vault: create, search, copy and manage technician passwords.
adminBackupSummarySub: Backup center: 5 latest (system, JSON, code, ZIP) with individual restore and auto copy.
fichaCadastralSubtitle: Identity, billing and bank details stored in the system — they feed the client-facing documents.
fichaCadastralTransferencia: For payment by transfer, confirm NIB/IBAN and SWIFT in the registration; use the «Payment / transfer details sheet» or the PDF generated in registration, depending on your workflow.
fichaPagamentoTransferenciaSubtitle: Summary of bank details saved in registration — generate the document for the client to pay.
fichaPagamentoTransferenciaInfo: Data comes from « Nonato Service registration ». Edit there to change NIB, IBAN or contacts.
fichaPagamentoEnvioNoCadastro: To send email or WhatsApp with suggested text and attachment, also use « Send to client » on the registration screen.
fichaFaturaClienteTitle: SHEET FOR THE CLIENT TO ISSUE AN INVOICE
fichaFaturaClienteSubtitle: Name, tax ID, address and contacts only — no bank details — for the client to invoice Nonato Service.
fichaFaturaClienteInfo: Fields are read from saved registration. No NIB or IBAN.
fichaFaturaClienteGeradoDescricao: Save or send this file to the client for their invoicing software. No bank details.
fichaFaturaClienteGeradoNenhum: The invoice document has not yet been generated in this browser.
fichaFaturaClienteGeradoErro: Could not generate the document. Check your connection and try again.
cadastroNonatoServiceSubtitle: Bank and contact details for the client to make the deposit or payment transfer.
cadastroNonatoServiceInfo: Fill in the details above. When you generate the PDF, the client will receive a clear document with bank and contact details to make the deposit or transfer to Nonato Service.
cadastroNonatoServiceGerarPdf: Generate PDF to send to client
cadastroNonatoEnvioAjuda: The file to attach is the one in « Generated registration ». The buttons open email or WhatsApp; when you click, the saved document opens in another tab so you can print or save as PDF and attach.
cadastroNonatoGeradoDescricao: The document created with « Generate PDF to send to client » is stored here. You can open it again, download the HTML, or clear it. When sending, attach this same file.
cadastroNonatoGeradoNenhum: No document saved in this browser yet. Use « Generate PDF to send to client » to create and save.
cadastroNonatoGeradoErro: Could not generate the document. Check your connection and try again.
cadastroNonatoEnvioHintCorpoComDoc: (The official document just opened in another tab — use Print / Save as PDF or attach the HTML file downloaded from « Generated registration ».)
cadastroNonatoEnvioHintCorpoSemDoc: (Generate and save the document with « Generate PDF to send to client » before sending; then attach the file.)
cadastroNonatoEnvioPlaceholderCliente: — Select client from registry (fills email and phone) —
cadastroNonatoEnvioHintCliente: Data comes from the Clients section. You can edit the fields below; if you edit manually, the link to the selected client is cleared.
empresaInstitucionalSubtitle: Company record, payment sheet and client invoice sheet, plus technical service requests
empresaInstitucionalHubIntro: A dedicated area for Nonato Service institutional data: full company record (editing and document for deposit/transfer), summary sheet for payment, minimal sheet for the client to issue an invoice (no bank details), and a standardised technical service request workflow.
empresaInstSidebarItemCadastro: Commercial data, contacts and identity across reports
empresaInstSidebarItemFicha: Client-facing documents: payment and invoicing kept separate
empresaInstSidebarItemPagamento: Bank details and transfer to your account
empresaInstSidebarItemFaturaCliente: Minimum billing details for the client to invoice Nonato
empresaInstSidebarItemSolicitacao: Structured form to request a technical intervention
empresaInstHubCardCadastro: Configure how the company appears on PDFs, proposals and system-generated communications.
empresaInstHubCardFicha: Two HTML outputs: transfer/payment (with bank details) and client invoice (billing and contact only).
empresaInstHubCardPagamento: Generate HTML with NIB/IBAN and SWIFT so the client can pay by transfer.
empresaInstHubCardFaturaCliente: Generate HTML with invoicing details only, no bank account.
empresaInstHubCardSolicitacao: Log assistance requests with clear criteria and linked technical history.
selectGroupForButtons: Select the group for each button:
organizeButtonsFreeGroupDesc: You can move any button to any group. E.g.: a button from Technical Management can be moved to Industrial Management. Use the menu next to each button to choose the group.
incluirLogoNosRelatoriosDesc: When enabled, the logo configured above appears in the header of service reports exported as PDF.
escolherLogoRelatoriosDesc: Select the main logo or one of the logos added below to appear in the PDFs.
incluirLogoFechamentosDespesas: Include logo in Report Expense Closing PDFs
incluirLogoFechamentosDespesasDesc: When enabled, the logo chosen below appears in the expense closing PDF documents for service reports.
escolherLogoFechamentosDesc: Use the main logo or one of the logos added above (Reports).
escolherLogoOrcamentoPecasDesc: Standalone quotes, parts requests and proposals with library lines.
escolherLogoOrcamentoServicoDesc: Technical service proposals on letterhead (hours, km, per diems, etc.).
escolherLogoDocumentosDesc: Technical service requests and other PDF documents generated by the system.
escolherLogoChecklistDesc: Forms and checklists generated for field technicians.
escolherLogoPreChecklistDesc: Pre-operational verification before the technical intervention.
adminLogosHubDesc: Choose the right logo for each situation: reports, expenses, quotes, documents, sidebar menu and home screen.
adminLogosBibliotecaDesc: Saved images for reuse. Upload here or directly in each situation.
adminLogosInterfaceDesc: Image or MP4 video for the sidebar and home screen. Pick a file, preview it, then click «Save» to persist; «Discard draft» cancels without changing what was already saved.
adminLogoSalvarParaAplicar: Not saved yet — use «Save» to apply or «Discard draft» to cancel.
adminLogoServidorIndisponivel: Saved on this device, but the server did not confirm (network or limit). After reload, this device keeps the new content; others may show the old one until sync completes.
adminLogosPdfDesc: Pick an image, check the preview, then click «Save to library» to persist; «Discard draft» cancels. Then choose the logo for each PDF step. “Main logo” = sidebar image (video is not used in PDFs).
adminLogosPdfDescCompact: Attach the logo image, click «Save to library» and confirm the preview. Check «Include in PDF».
pdfLogosModoUnificadoLabel: One logo for all documents (reports, expenses, quotes, documents, protocols, checklists)
pdfLogosModoAjuda: Use one logo everywhere, or pick different images per situation. The image library is shared in both modes.
pdfLogosUnificadoSub: Reports, expenses, parts and service quotes, documents, protocols, checklist and pre-checklist share the same header image.
brandSituationsDesc: Same base file; context-adjusted color (CSS). Useful for alerts, financial, debt, information and success.
adminSemLogoPdf: No image in this situation yet

There is no specific help text for this screen yet; use the general manual or contact the administrator.

---COMO---

• Press F1 in another section to see examples of contextual help.
• Open the «Program manual» from the menu when available.
• If unsure, note the screen and ask for internal support.
helpShortcut: Press F1 in any section to open this help.
helpDashboardPainel:
This is the system entry and summary panel.

---COMO---

• Use «Enter the system» for full statistics and shortcuts.
• Open features from the side menu; each module shows Home at the top (returns to the panel and closes tabs) and Help (or the F1 key).
• To sign out, use «Exit system» at the bottom of the side menu.
helpFooterPainel: Tip: Help on this page describes the panel; in modules it describes the open screen. The F1 key does the same.
helpFooterModulo: Questions about this module: use the Help button here or the F1 key.
helpEquipamentos:
Used to register and view all warehouse equipment: technical data, family/group, PDF manuals, stock and decommissioning history.

---COMO---

• Click «Add» and fill in ID, family and group.
• Upload the PDF manual on the equipment record when available.
• Use filters by family or brand to find items quickly.
• When equipment leaves permanently, use decommissioning to keep history correct.
helpGestores:
Used to create and maintain profiles for managers and technicians (areas, contacts and permissions) across the operation.

---COMO---

• Click «Add» for a new manager or technician and choose the type (technical/industrial area, internal, external or warehouse).
• Fill required fields and contacts; save before leaving.
• Edit a record when role or contact changes.
• Use internal messaging when your profile allows it.
helpClientes:
Used as the central register of clients and installed equipment, the basis for service reports and history.

---COMO---

• Create a client with company, address, contacts and tax ID.
• On the client record, register equipment (model, brand, serial no.) and attach images if needed.
• Use search or filters before opening orders or reports.
• Update data when installation or contact changes.
helpFamiliasGrupos:
Used to structure families and groups for pre-operational and final checklists.

---COMO---

• Create the family first, then add groups inside it.
• Name items consistently so technicians recognise them on screen.
• Edit or reorder when company processes change.
• Check each group belongs to the correct family before field use.
helpFamiliasGruposEquipamentos:
Used to classify warehouse equipment by family and group, making filtering and linking to manuals and checklists easier.

---COMO---

• Define broad families and more specific groups.
• Assign each registered item to the correct family/group.
• Use these criteria when filtering lists or preparing orders.
• Keep the tree aligned with real warehouse naming.
helpChecklistHub:
Used as the single entry point to Pre-Checklist, Checklist, group management, preparation order and technician forms.

---COMO---

• Choose the button for the task (before visit, during job, parts preparation, etc.).
• Complete each flow in the logical service order.
• If unsure which to open, identify the service phase and matching module.
• Return to the hub to switch tools without losing the main menu.
helpAlmoxarifadoArmazem:
Used to control inventory, goods in/out and parts stock linked to technician requests.

---COMO---

• Record stock receipts and issues for services or internal consumption.
• Check stock levels and critical references.
• Cross-check with parts requests to prepare picking.
• Adjust after physical stocktakes when required.
helpPreChecklist:
Used to record checks and needs before starting work on the equipment.

---COMO---

• Link the pre-checklist to equipment by ID or serial number.
• Go through group items and mark what is verified.
• State required parts or resources if the form allows.
• Save before moving to the operational checklist or visit.
helpChecklist:
Used to document tasks and checks during the job, linked to the client and service report.

---COMO---

• Select client and equipment according to the job.
• Fill each checklist group with applicable items.
• Stay consistent with the pre-checklist and logged parts.
• Finish and save so the report reflects the work done.
helpManuaisInformacoesTecnicas:
Used to consult manuals and technical data already linked to equipment (PDFs registered in the warehouse).

---COMO---

• Pick equipment from the list or search.
• Open the PDF or available technical information.
• If documentation is missing, go to «Warehouse equipment register» and upload the manual on the record.
• Keep versions updated by replacing the file when the manufacturer revises it.
helpBibliaNonatoService:
Dedicated space for working references: equipment families, brands and model lists. It does not replace «Manuals and technical information» or warehouse PDFs.

---COMO---

• Create a family and select it on the left.
• For each line optionally type the brand or group.
• In models enter comma-separated references or one per line.
• Use the top search to find text anywhere.
• Data saves automatically in this module.
helpComunicacaoInterna:
Used to exchange messages and alerts between managers and technicians inside the system.

---COMO---

• Open a conversation or channel shown on screen.
• Write clear messages with client or order reference when helpful.
• Check pending notifications and alerts regularly.
• For real-time chat, also use the communication hub if it is in the menu.
helpDesmontados:
Used to track equipment in dismantling, waiting for parts or intermediate storage.

---COMO---

• Log entries in the list with equipment identification.
• Update status as dismantling progresses or reassembly happens.
• Add notes on missing parts or equipment condition.
• Remove or archive when the cycle closes per internal policy.
helpRelatorioServico:
Used to formalise the service: client, equipment, technician, days and type of intervention, with PDF export.

---COMO---

• Create a new report or edit a draft.
• Link the correct client and equipment; fill technician and work period.
• Include notes and parts aligned with the checklist.
• Generate PDF and send or archive per process.
helpBibliotecaPecas:
Used as a catalogue of part codes and descriptions for requests, checklists and reports.

---COMO---

• Add or edit parts with consistent code, description and category.
• Use groups/subgroups to make search easier.
• When logging a part on a job, prefer picking from the library to avoid duplicates.
• Use bulk import from CSV/JSON or URL on the «Import» tab.
helpGestaoCustos:
Used to analyse costs by service, client or period and support decisions and closings.

---COMO---

• Set the period and available filters.
• Cross-check with service reports and parts to validate totals.
• Export or print when external archiving is needed.
• Refresh base data (prices, categories) in catalogues before closing analyses.
helpGestaoFinanceira:
Used as the central financial area: invoices, financial clients, quotes, expenses and receipts.

---COMO---

• Navigate tabs or subsections of the module.
• Record documents with correct dates and clients.
• Link receipts and expenses to services when the workflow requires it.
• Use financial reports to reconcile with external accounting.
helpGestaoDemos:
It is used to prepare and send system demo packages (which modules and shortcuts the recipient can see) without exposing real production data. 

---HOW--- 

• Choose the profile or demo package indicated on the screen (basic, commercial, technical, etc.). 
• Select or uncheck modules depending on what you want to show to the customer or partner. 
• Generate or copy demo link for authorized people only. 
• Confirm that you do not include sensitive data before sending. 
• After the demo, ask for feedback and disable expired links if internal policy requires it.
helpAdministrador:
Used to administer users, permissions, backups and sensitive system settings.

---COMO---

• Create or edit users with appropriate roles (least privilege).
• Review periodically who has administrator and critical report access.
• Run backups per the options shown.
• Document important changes for support.
helpUsers:
Used for system user management (roles and passwords).

---COMO---

• Add a user with correct email and role.
• Set initial password or invitation per application flow.
• Edit or deactivate accounts when someone leaves.
• Do not share credentials; one account per person.
helpExtras:
Used for extra options or integrations configured on this installation.

---COMO---

• Read each option before enabling.
• Save changes and test in a safe environment if possible.
• If unsure, note the option name and ask the administrator.
• Revert if daily work is negatively affected.
helpCadastroNonatoService:
Used for the institutional Nonato Service register (data used on documents and communications).

---COMO---

• Fill name, tax ID, bank details and required fields.
• Upload the logo when prompted for PDFs and headers.
• Check previews before sending to the client.
• Update when bank or legal data changes.
• For HTML with bank details only (payment) or tax and contact details only (client-issued invoice), use the dedicated tabs after saving here.
helpFichaCadastral:
Summary of company data stored in the register. Client-facing output is split: transfer/payment (with bank) and client-issued invoice (no bank), each in its own tab.

---COMO---

• Keep «Nonato Service registration» up to date.
• Generate the right document under «Payment / transfer details sheet» or «Sheet for the client to issue an invoice».
• Validate tax ID, address and IBAN before sharing.
helpFichaPagamentoTransferencia:
Read-only summary with NIB/IBAN/SWIFT and contacts so the client can pay by transfer; values come from the saved registration.

---COMO---

• Confirm changes are saved in «Nonato Service registration».
• Generate HTML/PDF using the buttons on this tab.
• For email or WhatsApp with suggested text and attachment, also use «Send to client» in the registration.
helpFichaFaturaCliente:
Minimum document (name, tax ID, address, contacts, logo) for the client to invoice Nonato — no bank details.

---COMO---

• Fill in and save the registration.
• Generate the HTML and send or download it for the client’s billing software.
• If a required field is missing, fix it in the registration and regenerate.
helpFornecedores:
Used to register suppliers of parts and services and keep contacts handy for orders.

---COMO---

• Click «Add» and fill name, contact and tax data if available.
• Use notes for payment terms or usual lead times.
• Search before creating near-duplicate names.
• Update when the commercial contact or phone changes.
helpPecasSubstituicao:
Used to log and view replacement parts linked to services or equipment.

---COMO---

• Enter code and quantity aligned with the parts library when possible.
• Link to client or equipment per the form.
• Confirm warehouse stock before promising dates.
• Document on the service report for traceability.
helpImportacaoPecas:
Used to import part lists from URL, CSV/JSON file or pasted text.

---COMO---

• Choose the import mode that matches the source.
• Validate column mapping (code, description, price) before confirming.
• Run a small test import first.
• Fix reported errors and re-import if needed.
helpSolicitacaoServicoTecnico:
Used to generate technical service requests to the client (equipment, problem, signature).

---COMO---

• Fill client and equipment identification accurately.
• Describe the problem clearly for the field technician.
• Capture signature on screen when applicable.
• Send via email or WhatsApp using the buttons.
helpAgenda:
Used to plan visits, technician appointments, personal matters, technical visits (no client), time off and day status (calendar or list).

---COMO---

• Create an entry with date, technician and client (service) or choose «Personal matter» / «Technical visit» (no client or equipment).
• Filter by technician, type (incl. personal matters) or period.
• In calendar mode, click the day for details or edits.
• Check «Pending personal matters» before scheduling client service.
• Set status to match reality.
helpCadastroServicos:
Used to define service types, descriptions or tables used in reports and agenda.

---COMO---

• Add or edit each type with a standardised name.
• Link durations or notes if the form allows.
• Keep the list aligned with field terminology.
• Deactivate obsolete entries instead of deleting if history matters.
helpFechamentoRelatoriosServicos:
Used for period closings and consolidation of service reports (review and export).

---COMO---

• Select date range and required filters.
• Review totals and exceptions before closing the period.
• Export or print the summary for archive or accounting.
• Fix missing reports before final close.
helpTranslator:
Used as help and tooling for translating interface text or internal content.

---COMO---

• Enter text or pick the resource indicated on screen.
• Save approved translations for consistency across languages.
• Always review before production.
• Align vocabulary with the team.
helpEstadoVisualTecnico:
Used to visualise technician status or availability in a summary panel.

---COMO---

• Use filters and legend to interpret colours or icons.
• Click a technician for details when available.
• Refresh if data looks stale.
• Combine with the agenda to plan visits.
helpInformacoesConhecimentoTecnicos:
Used as a knowledge base, documents or notes for internal technicians.

---COMO---

• Search by keyword or category before duplicating content.
• Add articles with a clear title and short steps.
• Attach files or links when they are official sources.
• Update when procedures or equipment change.
helpBibliotecaRelatorios:
Used for saved templates and reports reusable for viewing or printing.

---COMO---

• Choose the report from the list or search.
• Open the template and verify data before sending to the client.
• Duplicate or adapt when you need a variant.
• Keep file naming consistent for archiving.
helpRelatoriosExcluidosClientes:
Used to list excluded or client-filtered reports (audit).

---COMO---

• Confirm period and client in filters.
• Analyse the reason for exclusion or filter recorded in the system.
• Restore or regenerate only if internal policy allows.
• Document decisions outside the system when needed.
helpClientesFinanceiro:
Used for the financial view of clients (accounts, documents, open amounts).

---COMO---

• Select client and period.
• Open each document for detail and payment status.
• Cross-check with receipts and invoices in financial management.
• Export or print statements when the client needs proof.
helpComprovantesDespesas:
Used to log and view receipts for card-paid expenses for your tax return (client or NONATO SERVICE expenses).

---COMO---

• Choose type (client vs NONATO SERVICE expenses) before saving.
• Attach or scan the receipt.
• Fill amount, date and description.
• Save and check totals before month-end or for your accountant.
helpOrcamentosAvulso:
Used to create and manage quotes outside a standard contract flow.

---COMO---

• Create lines with description, quantities and prices.
• Link the client and validate totals and taxes.
• Generate PDF or send per buttons.
• Archive versions when the client asks for revisions.

• Track status until an approved quote exists.
• Link to the corresponding quote when it exists.
• Close the request when answered or cancelled.
helpRegistroDespesas:
Used to log general expenses (purchases, travel, etc.) with categories.

---COMO---

• Click new entry and fill date, amount and category.
• Attach invoice or receipt when the process requires it.
• Review periodically to avoid duplicates.
• Integrate with receipts and financial closings when applicable.
helpPagamentosContador:
Record payments to tax and professional entities (IRS, social security, lawyer, accountant) with accounting attachments.

---COMO---

• Register entities in the Entities tab.
• Log each payment with date, amount, reference period and status (paid/pending).
• Attach PDF or photo of the accounting invoice/receipt.
• Filter by month, date range, entity or status.
• Export PDF for the accountant with payments matching the current filter.
helpHubComunicacao:
Used as a real-time communication hub between teams (conversations and alerts).

---COMO---

• Pick channel or conversation in the list.
• Write short messages with context (client, order).
• Enable browser notifications if prompted.
• Archive old conversations per internal policy.
helpMensagensInternas:
Used for internal messages between users (inbox and sent).

---COMO---

• Open a message to read the full thread.
• Reply or compose with a clear subject.
• Use correct recipients to avoid leaks.
• Do not send passwords or sensitive data in plain text.
helpMensagensInternasTecnicos:
Used for internal messages aimed at technicians (field or warehouse alerts).

---COMO---

• Choose technicians or groups per screen.
• Mark urgency in subject or body.
• Confirm read receipt if the system allows.
• Cross-check with the agenda for availability.
helpTecnicosInternos:
Used to list and manage internal technicians (data, availability, permissions).

---COMO---

• Add or edit cards with contact and specialty.
• Assign roles or teams per org chart.
• Deactivate accounts for departures.
• Cross-check with the agenda for planning.
helpTecnicosExternos:
Used to register external technicians or partners who help occasionally.

---COMO---

• Record name, contact and supplier company.
• Document agreements or limits in notes.
• Collect only necessary data for privacy.
• Update when the partner stops providing service.
helpAlertaMensagens:
Used for alerts and message notifications (priority or unread).

---COMO---

• Read each alert and open the linked conversation.
• Mark as read or complete the requested action.

helpGestaoGruposChecklist:
Used to create and maintain detailed checklist item groups.

helpMapaVisualSeparacaoPecas:

helpOrdemPreparacao:
Used for parts preparation orders before sending to technician or client.

• Generate or open the order from approved requests.

helpFormulariosChecklistTecnicos:

• Pick the form that matches the service type.
• Fill all required fields before signing.

helpVerificacaoFinalEntrega:

helpProtocolosServico:
Used to document technical visits with traceability: client (required), equipment from the register or a written situation, introductory text, text-only blocks, image-only blocks or combined actions (text + images), replaced parts aligned with the parts library, PDF template and sending.

---COMO---

• Use the opening text for context (reason for visit, condition before); in later blocks describe steps, readings or conclusions.

---COMO---

importacaoGuiaHomag2: 2) Go to the desired parts list.
importacaoGuiaHomagUrlImagens: 2b) shop.homag.com uses JavaScript: «Search from URL» in the app does not bring a list or images. Pasting only text brings codes/names but not photos. With images: on PC, in the project folder, copy scripts/homag-import/config.example.json → config.json, set startUrl with the category link, install Playwright (npx playwright install chromium), run HOMAG_MANUAL=1 npm run homag:import — log in to the window, Enter in the terminal — then import scripts/homag-import/out/export.json in the Library.

1. Nature of this document
This is a non-fiscal technical service quote based on the service / rate register. It does not replace a service order, contract or tax documents.

2. Travel, accommodation, meals and transport
Unless expressly agreed otherwise in writing, all costs for team travel (including road transport, fuel, tolls and, where applicable, air tickets), hotel accommodation and meals are borne by the contracting customer.

3. Crew size, overtime and unforeseen costs
Any increase in headcount, longer on-site time, overtime or costs outside this quote require prior written approval from the customer. Without such approval, no extra charges will be recognised.

4. Personal or unrelated expenses
Personal, social or non-job-related expenses, and any cost not directly and demonstrably linked to the quoted technical service, are excluded.

5. Validity and acceptance
Accepting this quote means the conditions above were read and understood. After the stated validity, prices and availability may change.

6. Disputes
Applicable law governs interpretation and disputes, to the extent permitted.
